description: SPIRE / GCN / GAT trained per-region. Each region forms its own graph. ~15% of each region's nodes randomly held out as test (strictly inductive: each test node augmented one-by-one into the train+val graph), Comment (4)-A (was a fixed n=5); train/val candidates within each region's own mean k-NN distance of a test node are excluded (Comment (4)-B spatial buffering), see each region's own `split_info`. SPIRE tuned; GCN and GAT reuse the same best config.
_note_split_manifest: Runs restricted to the five pinned seeds defined in result/split_manifest_per_region.json; earlier runs on unseeded, non-manifest splits were removed rather than averaged in.
